EmailTemplate.subject: Payment delays due to Lunar New Year Holiday
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
With banks in China, Korea and Vietnam closing February 11 to 17 for the Lunar New Year holiday, incoming payments to Flywire and your institution may be delayed until after the holiday.
Please reach out if you have any questions.
